name: (UPDATE)Full Self Driving/Autopilot Simulator
desc:
Welcome to Autopilot Simulator!

We are the most realistic Tesla-related game on Roblox. You can drive around on Autopilot or FSD with 100+ ICE, Hybrid, and Electric vehicles. Traverse a spacious map with many buildings and roads to explore! 🛣️

Join Community Groups: https://www.roblox.com/communities/16790742/Plaid-Studio#!/about
